_readme: Demo travelers for testing the Travelers tab, matching, pins and messaging.
These are NOT real people: the portraits are AI-generated, so no real
person's likeness is used. Every bio ends with a visible [demo] marker and
the runbook requires purging them before real users arrive.
photoUrl values are time-limited generation links, and the window is SHORT:
the 2026-09-08 batch was signed for roughly 24 to 48 hours. They only matter
at seed time - once uploaded the photos live in Supabase Storage and the link
expiring costs nothing. But it means you cannot regenerate today and seed next
week: the links WILL be dead, the seed's photo upload catches the failure and
logs ::warning::photo for <slug> skipped, and the run still reports success
with twelve faceless travelers. Regenerate and seed in the same sitting, then
check storage.objects for profile-photos went up by twelve. If a link has
expired, ask Claude to regenerate the portraits before re-seeding.
ORDER MATTERS. The seed script derives each trip schedule from the index:
rotation = index % 4 picks which launch city they are in TODAY (Lisbon,
Bangkok, Mexico City, Denpasar, then repeat), and index / 4 picks how far
their later trips are pushed out. cities[] is one trip per city in window
order, four in all, which is the active-trip cap minus one. The result:
three travelers live in every city right now (so every city has avatar
pins), and at least three matches in any city for any trip in the next
four months. Reordering or dropping people breaks that, so re-check the
coverage if you edit this list.

slug is the ACCOUNT identity: it makes the plus-addressed email and it is what purge iterates. Never change a slug without purging first, or the old account survives the purge with nothing pointing at it. Names and genders are free to change; they are just profile fields the seed rewrites.
Genders are spread so every filter in "who can see you" has somebody to find: men in Bangkok, Mexico City and Denpasar; women in all four; non-binary in Lisbon, Bangkok and Denpasar.

people.name: Maya
people.bio: Coffee first, plans later. Currently chasing good pastries and cheap flights. Always up for a walk with no destination. [demo]

prompts.answer: find the pastry that ruins every other pastry
coffee, no map, and whatever street looks best
I will do the ordering and you can just show up

people.replyOpener: Ah yes, glad you said something. I am doing coffee then wandering most mornings, join me whenever.
people.pingMessage: Hey! We are here the same days it looks like. I am doing a pastry and coffee crawl this week, no agenda, come along if you want.

people.name: Dev
people.bio: Six months into a very slow trip around Asia. I will absolutely talk your ear off about street food. Looking for people to explore with. [demo]

prompts.answer: a bowl of boat noodles from a stall with four stools
eat at a place I would never walk into alone
one shirt too few and a lot of hot sauce

people.replyOpener: Yes! I have a running list of street food places and nobody to drag along, so your timing is perfect.
people.pingMessage: Hey, looks like we overlap. I am eating my way through the night markets this week if you want in.

people.name: Sofia
people.bio: Architect, so I will make you look at a building. Here for the food mostly. Say hi if you are around. [demo]

prompts.answer: a market, a long lunch, then a building I came to see
eat at a different taqueria every single night
I already know where we are going. Just say yes

people.replyOpener: Oh good, someone else who eats dinner at ten. I am free most evenings this week.
people.pingMessage: Hey, looks like we overlap. I am doing a taco crawl through Roma this week, come along.

people.name: Priya
people.bio: Nurse on a very long break. Learning to surf badly and loving it. Around most mornings. [demo]

prompts.answer: learn to actually surf instead of falling off
in the water early, doing nothing by four
a warung lunch that cost about two pounds

people.replyOpener: Yes please. I am out there most mornings around seven, come find me.
people.pingMessage: Hey, we are here the same days. I surf badly at Batu Bolong most mornings if you fancy it.

people.name: Nora
people.bio: Taking a proper break from work for once. Museums in the morning, long dinners at night. Say hi if you like either. [demo]

prompts.answer: far too many books and one pair of socks
a long breakfast, then get properly lost
I know where the good bookshop is. All of them

people.replyOpener: Lovely, I was after some company for dinner. I do museums in the morning and long dinners at night, pick either.
people.pingMessage: Hi there, looks like our dates line up. I am doing museums then a long dinner this week if you fancy either one.

people.name: Theo
people.bio: Here for the night markets and the questionable karaoke. I take photos of everything, sorry in advance. [demo]

prompts.answer: som tam so spicy I could not speak for ten minutes
go to the market at 6am and cook the results
the famous restaurant is almost never the best one

people.replyOpener: Great, I need someone to keep me from taking 400 photos of the same noodle stall. When are you free?
people.pingMessage: Hey, we seem to be here the same week. Night market and questionable karaoke is the plan, you are very welcome to join.

people.name: Marcus
people.bio: Teacher with a summer to fill. Will happily watch any sport in any language. Bad at sitting still. [demo]

prompts.answer: go to the football and shout about it
running shoes I will use exactly once
a 5am sunrise hike. I have seen the sun

people.replyOpener: Ha, yes. I have two tickets and nobody to shout next to. You are in.
people.pingMessage: Hey! Same dates it looks like. I am going to the lucha on Friday if you want a ticket.

people.name: Tomas
people.bio: Carpenter. Came for two weeks in 2023 and keep coming back. Will drive to the quiet break. [demo]

prompts.answer: ride out to a break nobody else is at
the beach everyone rates is always too busy
one board bag and almost nothing else

people.replyOpener: Nice. I have a scooter and a spare board, so you have no excuse now.
people.pingMessage: Hey, our dates line up. Heading somewhere quieter than Canggu on Thursday, room for one.

people.name: Ines
people.bio: Work in film so my hours are strange. Best conversations happen after midnight. Very slow mornings. [demo]

prompts.answer: a very slow morning, then walking until dark
a rooftop bar with a queue
I know the tiny cinema that shows the good stuff

pin.venue: Late film at the little cinema

people.replyOpener: Finally, someone who is also awake. There is a late screening on Wednesday if you want.
people.pingMessage: Hey, we overlap. There is a tiny cinema near me showing something odd on Wednesday, come.

people.name: Kai
people.bio: Meant to be writing a thesis. Am instead eating my way across the night markets. Happy to share a table. [demo]

prompts.answer: eat something at every night market I pass
talk nonsense over cheap beer until late
grilled pork and sticky rice at 1am for almost nothing

people.replyOpener: Great. I have a list and it is far too long for one person. Pick a night.
people.pingMessage: Hey, same dates. I am doing the night markets all week and eating far too much, join me.

people.name: Freja
people.bio: Hiker, swimmer, terrible at sitting still. If there is a trail nearby I have probably already looked it up. [demo]

prompts.answer: swim somewhere that is a bit too cold
sit by a pool all day. I will lose my mind
walk up something, eat everything on the way down

people.replyOpener: Nice, I was hoping someone would say yes. I am walking the coast path this week, easy pace, good swim halfway.
people.pingMessage: Hi! Saw we are around at the same time. I am doing a coast walk with a swim stop, tell me if that is your kind of thing.

people.name: Luca
people.bio: First big trip and loving it. Staying in hostels, saying yes to most things. Teach me a card game. [demo]

prompts.answer: find one bar with a band nobody has heard of
stay out slightly too late on a weeknight
the second best city is always better than the best one

pin.venue: Beach bar with an actual band

people.replyOpener: Yes! First big trip and I am saying yes to everything, so tell me what you are doing and I am in.
people.pingMessage: Hey! We are in town at the same time. I am staying at a hostel with a decent rooftop, come hang out if you are free.
